pr_title: Continue ADR 0122 spatial audio ECS synchronization
pr_body: Continues ADR 0122 on the existing Draft PR after the engine-owned listener/emitter ECS synchronization slice. This request adds authoring-facing spatial options without changing stable component IDs: Audio Emitter and Audio Listener schemas advance to version 2 with linear/inverse rolloff, looping, and listener priority defaults; existing AudioEmitter::new behavior remains linear and non-looping; runtime listener selection prefers the greatest priority with deterministic Entity fallback; and authored autoplay uses the selected rolloff and loop policy. Shared scene-level warning diagnostics and Project Rust spatial playback remain in following validated slices.
